benefits_summary: High-interest (8.2% p.a.) tax-free savings account for a girl child's education and marriage expenses, with Section 80C tax deduction up to ₹1,50,000.
exclusions: Girl child above 10 years of age
More than two girl children per family (unless twins/triplets)
application_steps: Visit any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.
Fill out the Sukanya Samriddhi Account opening form (Form SSA-1).
Submit the birth certificate and guardian ID with an initial deposit (minimum ₹250).
